action-throttleoverride: Ku dar ka dhaafitaanno xaddidaadaha heerka
log-description-throttleoverride: Kani waa diiwaanka ka dhaafitaannada u oggolaanaya isticmaalayaasha inay ka gudbaan xaddidaadaha heerka. Xaddidaadaha heerka waxaa loogu talagalay in looga hortago spam-ka iyadoo la xaddidayo falalka qaarkood (tusaale, tirada akoonnada la abuuri karo ama isticmaalka Special:Emailuser).
right-throttleoverride: Ka dhaaf cinwaannada IP-yada ama kala duwanaanshahooda qaarkood xaddidaadaha heerka
throttleoverride-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in laga gudbo xaddidaadaha cinwaannada IP-ga
throttleoverride-text:
Geli cinwaanka IP-ga ama kala duwanaanshaha aad rabto in laga dhaafo xaddidaadaha qaarkood, iyo muddada ka dhaafitaanku soconayo.
Sabab ikhtiyaari ah ayaa lagu qori karaa diiwaannada.
throttleoverride-showlog: Cinwaankan IP-ga ama kala-duwanaanshahan hore ayaa looga dhaafay xaddidaadaha. Diiwaanka hoose ayaa loo bixiyey tixraac ahaan.
throttleoverride-success:
Ka dhaafitaanka $1 waa la dabaqay.
Eeg [[Special:ThrottleOverrideList|liiska ka-dhaafitaannada xaddidaadaha]] si aad dib ugu eegto ka-dhaafitaannada.
throttleoverride-success-sub: Ka gudubka xaddidaadda waa lagu guulaystay
throttleoverride-types-mailpassword: Iimayllada soo celinta erayga sirta ah
throttleoverride-list-noresults: Liiska ka gudubka xaddidaadaha waa madhan.
throttleoverride-log-type-mailpassword: Iimaylka soo celinta erayga sirta ah
throttleoverride-validation-ipinvalid: Cinwaan IP ama kala duwanaansho cinwaanno IP ah oo aan sax ahayn.
throttleoverride-validation-rangedisable: Awoodda lagu abuuro ka dhaafitaannada xaddidaadaha kala-duwanaanshaha cinwaannada IP-ga waa naafo.
throttleoverride-validation-rangetoolarg: Ka dhaafitaannada xaddidaadaha ee kala duwanaanshaha cinwaannada IP-ga ee ka weyn $1 lama oggola.
throttleoverride-validation-expiryinvali: Waqtiga dhicitaanka oo aan sax ahayn.
throttleoverride-rule-alreadyexists: Waxaa jira ka-dhaafitaan hore oo loogu talagalay $1. Waxaad ka eegi kartaa dejimaha jira [[Special:ThrottleOverrideList|liiska ka-dhaafitaannada xaddidaadaha]], ama waxaad wax ka beddeli kartaa dejimaha xeerka jira adigoo mar kale gudbinaya foomkan.
